description: Writes the workflow and package.json changes from plan_trusted_publishing to disk (no git commit, no network writes). Returns the plan with status "applied" and the steps the user must still do with npm 2FA (npm trust commands, deleting the NPM_TOKEN secret).

npmArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the npm commands it generates.

npmVersion.description: npm version range for the inserted upgrade step. Default ^12; other versions may break publishing.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

readToken.description: Secret name (e.g. NPM_READ_TOKEN) of a read-only npm token to give install steps, for private org packages. Publish steps stay tokenless.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo, if the git remote is not "origin".

name: apply_trusted_publishing
title: Apply npm trusted publishing migration
